label: Daily question
help: Posts a conversation starter in a channel every day at a time you choose, and adds a !question command.
author: lucky-edgelord
description: Thirty friendly conversation starters. One is posted each day at the time you set, in the channel you set (in every community the bot serves that has it), and anyone can ask for another with !question. Set the channel, time and time zone under Settings → Daily question.

fields.label: Time zone
fields.help: A name like Europe/London or America/New_York

commands.name: question
